text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear \"No\" opening and repeated reasons","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a definite position right away and keeps that position explicit throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"three numbered reasons with separate paragraphs","quality":"organization","description":"It presents its argument in a more orderly structure with distinct points that are easy to follow."},{"evidence":"quoted article details like \"25 mph\" and liability question","quality":"textual support","description":"It uses specific evidence from the source article to support each main claim."},{"evidence":"\"So technically speaking\" and \"In my opinion\" explanations","quality":"reasoning development","description":"It does more than mention facts by explaining how the evidence supports the writer's stance."},{"evidence":"concluding restatement of reasons and preference for normal cars","quality":"conclusion control","description":"It ends by clearly summarizing the argument and reinforcing the position from the introduction."}]}
